findings.summary: ffprobe's refusal was caught as an absence, and four header fields were unasserted, so writing IEEE float instead of PCM left both wav tests green
determinism was proven on a score with the automation stripped, the likeliest source of a render that does not reproduce
the rewritten render-time criterion derived a weaker bound from the wrong constant and turned a missed soundcheck budget into a pass
the seed criterion is proven by the absence of code rather than by a test that could fail
findings.note: kept as a regression guard for the first feature that reads the seed at playback

findings.summary: two refusals shared context-in-use, which already means the context drives another engine
the render had no finally, so a rejected render left the ledger attached
neither offline guard had a test, including the one that would otherwise ship a transport-less render
nothing fails if the render gets slower; the criterion is a recorded measurement
the lesson that rendering the raw context returns silence was not written down
a legal document at +6 dB overshoots the limiter and encodeWav clamps 52 samples into the file with no error
findings.note: issue #70; the peak assertion runs before encoding on this path

findings.summary: the suite numbers were written before the card's last two tests and did not reproduce
a polyfill context without the globals passes both guards and dies inside standardized-audio-context
findings.note: recorded as a rule; the failure is immediate and named enough

findings.summary: a raw context that already rendered throws InvalidStateError rather than an EngineError
findings.note: issue #69, same root as the wrapper reuse

findings.summary: ffprobe read back only the duration, so the channel count was checked by nothing
